mechanism.plausibility_rationale: The mechanism of action described corresponds to Isoniazid, a first-line antitubercular agent. Isoniazid is well-documented to cause drug-induced liver injury (DILI) in a significant percentage of patients, ranging from asymptomatic elevation of serum aminotransferases to severe, potentially fatal hepatitis, due to the metabolic production of toxic intermediates like hydrazine.
